result.instructions: Tools for rapidmail, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many people subscribed to and left my newsletter list in the last 30 days?"; "What were the open and click rates of my latest newsletter?"; "Is jane.smith@example.com subscribed to my main list?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes rapidmail data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rapidmail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rapidmail_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rapidmail_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. rapidmail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rapidmail_list_recipientlists
tools.title: List recipient lists
tools.description: List the recipient lists (newsletter audiences) of the rapidmail account with id, name, description, whether unsubscribed recipients are blacklisted, and which is the default. Use the ids for recipients and mailing filters. GET /recipientlists.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: rapidmail_get_recipientlist
tools.title: Get recipient list
tools.description: One recipient list by id. GET /recipientlists/{id}.

tools.name: rapidmail_get_recipientlist_activity_stats
tools.title: Get recipient list activity stats
tools.description: Subscription activity of one recipient list between two dates (for example new subscriptions and unsubscriptions). The range may be at most one year, must not start before the list was created and must not lie in the future. GET /recipientlists/{id}/stats/activity.

to.description: End date, yyyy-mm-dd; later than from.

tools.name: rapidmail_list_recipients
tools.title: List recipients
tools.description: List the recipients (subscribers) of ONE recipient list, optionally filtered by e-mail address, external id or status. recipientlist_id is required. The long text fields (extrabig1-10) are only returned with include_extrabig. GET /recipients.

email.description: Only the recipient with this e-mail address.

foreign_id.description: Only the recipient with this external id.

status.description: Only recipients in these statuses: new (awaiting confirmation), active, bounced, abused, deleted.

include_extrabig.description: Also return the long text fields extrabig1-10 (default false).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: rapidmail_get_recipient
tools.title: Get recipient
tools.description: One recipient by id: e-mail, name, status, custom fields and timestamps. GET /recipients/{id}.

tools.name: rapidmail_create_recipient
tools.title: Add recipient
tools.description: WRITE: add ONE recipient (subscriber) to a recipient list. By default double opt-in is used: the recipient is created with status 'new' and rapidmail sends ONE confirmation e-mail to that address; they only receive newsletters after confirming. Set double_opt_in=false only if you hold the person's documented consent: the recipient is then stored as 'active' and no e-mail is sent (refused if the address was unsubscribed before). If a deleted recipient with the same address exists it is re-activated; an existing address returns a conflict error. Never use for bulk imports. POST /recipients.

recipientlist_id.description: rapidmail recipient list id to add the recipient to.

double_opt_in.description: true (default): status 'new' and a confirmation e-mail is sent to the address. false: status 'active', no e-mail (only with documented consent).

test_mode.description: true: validate only, nothing is saved and no e-mail is sent.

foreign_id.description: Your own external id for this contact.

tools.name: rapidmail_update_recipient
tools.title: Update recipient
tools.description: WRITE: partially update ONE recipient (only the fields you pass change): e-mail, name, custom fields. The status and the recipient list cannot be changed here, and no e-mail is sent. An e-mail address that already exists in the list returns a conflict error. PATCH /recipients/{id}.

foreign_id.description: Your own external id for this contact.

tools.name: rapidmail_unsubscribe_recipient
tools.title: Unsubscribe recipient
tools.description: WRITE: remove ONE recipient from their list. rapidmail only soft-deletes the record (status 'deleted', as if the person had unsubscribed) and the statistics count it as an unsubscription. No goodbye e-mail is sent. Single recipient only. DELETE /recipients/{id}.

tools.name: rapidmail_list_mailings
tools.title: List mailings
tools.description: List newsletters (mailings) with status, subject, sender, send time, recipient count and recipient lists. Filter by status, recipient list, created / updated / sent date. Read only: mailings are never created, sent or scheduled by this server. GET /mailings.

status.description: Mailing status, e.g. draft, scheduled, sending, sent.

recipientlist_id.description: Only mailings sent to this recipient list.

created_since.description: Only mailings created since this date/time.

updated_since.description: Only mailings updated since this date/time.

sent_from.description: Only mailings sent from this date/time.

sent_to.description: Only mailings sent up to this date/time (after sent_from).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: rapidmail_get_mailing
tools.title: Get mailing
tools.description: One mailing by id: status, subject, sender, destinations (recipient lists), send time, size and attachments. GET /mailings/{id}.

tools.name: rapidmail_get_mailing_stats
tools.title: Get mailing statistics
tools.description: Statistics of one sent mailing (opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscriptions and similar totals). GET /mailings/{id}/stats.

tools.name: rapidmail_list_mailing_activity
tools.title: List mailing recipient activity
tools.description: The recipients a mailing went to and what each did (delivered, opened, clicked, bounced). Detailed event information is only available if the respective plugin is enabled in the rapidmail account. GET /mailings/{id}/stats/activity.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: rapidmail_get_mailing_recipient_activity
tools.title: Get one recipient's activity in a mailing
tools.description: Delivery and engagement details of one recipient of one mailing. GET /mailings/{id}/stats/activity/{mailingrecipient_id}.

annotations.title: Get one recipient's activity in a mailing

tools.name: rapidmail_list_mailing_folders
tools.title: List mailing folders
tools.description: The folders used to organise mailings, with id and name. GET /mailings/folders.

tools.name: rapidmail_list_blacklist
tools.title: List blacklist entries
tools.description: The account's blacklist: e-mail addresses, domains and patterns that never receive mailings, with their type, source and dates. GET /blacklist.

created_since.description: Only entries created since this date/time.

updated_since.description: Only entries updated since this date/time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: rapidmail_list_transactional_emails
tools.title: List transactional e-mails
tools.description: Transactional (SMTP) e-mails sent through the rapidmail account: sender, recipient, subject, status (queued, delivered, bounced...), delivery diagnostics and open/click counts. Metadata only, no message bodies. Filter by date, status, project or address. GET /trx/emails.

date_from.description: From date, yyyy-mm-dd (not older than the account's retention).

has_attachments.description: Only mails with (true) or without (false) attachments.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with rapidmail
prompts.description: What you can do with rapidmail here, with example requests to try.
